name: CD3×5T4 in vitro activation and cytotoxicity scenarios
description: Source-aligned fixed-effect scenarios spanning untreated control, drug exposure, effector-to-target ratio, cell line, and measured CD3-affinity endpoints.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-468 untreated, E:T 4:1
scenarios.description: Null-control culture with 16,000 tumor cells and 64,000 resting T cells, matching the referenced assay setup.
scientific_questions: Does the no-drug culture preserve zero trimer, activation, effector differentiation, and drug-attributable cytotoxicity?
interpretation_guardrails: This is an in vitro null control, not a clinical no-treatment prediction.
Natural T-cell loss and tumor proliferation remain active.
Zero drug-attributable killing is evaluated against the parallel untreated tumor state.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-468 synapse-to-killing cascade, E:T 4:1
scenarios.description: Population fixed-effect 72-hour in vitro culture at 6.86 nM DuoBody-CD3x5T4 and the default 4:1 effector-to-target ratio.
scientific_questions: How does the reported 6.86 nM condition propagate from synapse formation to T-cell activation, effector accumulation, and delayed cytotoxicity over 72 hours?
interpretation_guardrails: The trajectory uses reported population fixed effects and is not an individual-culture prediction.

Raster-digitized Figure 2, 3, 6, and 7d comparators support private pointwise reproduction, but repeated figure renderings are non-independent and do not replace source arrays or culture-level donor records.
This assay concentration must not be converted into a clinical dose recommendation.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-468 DuoBody 6.86 nM, E:T 1:1
scenarios.description: Low-effector source-aligned condition with 16,000 resting T cells and 16,000 tumor cells.
scientific_questions: How does lowering the initial effector-to-target ratio change per-cell trimer density, effector production, and cytotoxicity?
interpretation_guardrails: Compare this condition with the E:T 4:1 and 8:1 scenarios as an assay-design sensitivity.
The model's R_ET factor makes per-cell synapse kinetics depend dynamically on both T-cell and tumor-cell pools.
The result is not a clinical immune-cell infiltration prediction.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-468 DuoBody 6.86 nM, E:T 8:1
scenarios.description: High-effector source-aligned condition with 128,000 resting T cells and 16,000 tumor cells.
scientific_questions: Does a larger initial effector pool increase aggregate effector function even when trimers per individual T cell change?
interpretation_guardrails: Interpret per-cell trimer and aggregate trimer load together.
This is a source-aligned assay condition, not a patient-level tumor microenvironment.
Raster-digitized Figure 5, 6, and 7d endpoint comparators support private pointwise reproduction, but they are repeated renderings of one assay observation rather than independent validations.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-468 DuoBody 6.86 nM, E:T 2:1
scenarios.description: Source-aligned intermediate-effector condition with 32,000 resting T cells and 16,000 tumor cells.
scientific_questions: How does the source-reported E:T 2:1 condition bridge the low- and high-effector assay responses?
interpretation_guardrails: Compare this condition with the E:T 1:1, 4:1, and 8:1 scenarios.
The result is an in vitro fixed-effect assay reconstruction, not a patient immune-infiltration prediction.
The published concentration grid was recovered by figure alignment and remains explicitly provenance-labeled.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-231 DuoBody 6.86 nM, E:T 4:1
scenarios.description: Cell-line covariate probe using the published MDA-MB-231 5T4 abundance, doubling time, activation threshold, and no-donor killing rate.
scientific_questions: How do the disclosed MDA-MB-231 antigen, growth, activation-threshold, and killing covariates alter the mechanistic cascade relative to MDA-MB-468?
interpretation_guardrails: The no-donor category maps to donor group 2 as disclosed in Supplement Table S4.
This comparison changes several measured or estimated cell-line attributes and is not a single-parameter causal attribution.
No tumor-type clinical efficacy inference is supported.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-468 high-affinity CD3 arm 6.86 nM, E:T 8:1
scenarios.description: Measured high-affinity endpoint using the 16 nM CD3 3D KD and corresponding 174 molecules/cell 2D KD.
scientific_questions: How does the measured 16 nM CD3-affinity variant alter synapse formation and downstream response at E:T 8:1?
interpretation_guardrails: The 16 nM 3D and 174 molecules/cell 2D KD values are paired measured endpoint values.
Affinity can alter both potency and hook-region behavior; do not assume monotonic benefit at every concentration.
This is candidate-design exploration in an in vitro model, not clinical optimization.

scenarios.name: MDA-MB-231 high-affinity CD3 arm 6.86 nM, E:T 8:1
scenarios.description: Source-reported MDA-MB-231 high-affinity assay condition using the complete published cell-line bundle and the measured 16 nM CD3-affinity endpoint.
scientific_questions: How does the measured high-affinity construct behave in the second breast-cancer cell-line profile?
interpretation_guardrails: Supplement Table S2 confirms the condition family, but the requested figures do not expose its exact observed endpoint at 6.86 nM.
The no-donor category maps to donor group 2.
Treat the trajectory as source-aligned and source-limited, not pointwise paper-validated.

scenarios.name: BxPC-3 DuoBody 6.86 nM, E:T 4:1
scenarios.description: Low-5T4 tumor-cell profile for exploring how weak target expression shapes the synapse-to-killing response.
scientific_questions: How does a low-5T4, relatively resistant cell-line profile change 72-hour killing?
interpretation_guardrails: The cell-line bundle changes antigen, growth, activation threshold, and killing susceptibility together.
The no-donor fixed effect is donor group 2.
Do not infer clinical pancreatic-tumor efficacy.

scenarios.name: EPLC-272H DuoBody 6.86 nM, E:T 4:1
scenarios.description: Intermediate-5T4 tumor-cell profile for exploring how target abundance shapes the synapse-to-killing response.
scientific_questions: How does the medium-5T4 EPLC-272H profile compare with the low- and high-density Figure 4 profiles?
interpretation_guardrails: The paper uses both EPLC-272H and EPLC272H spellings; this scenario uses the Table S1 spelling.
The no-donor fixed effect is donor group 2.
Do not attribute the response to antigen abundance alone.

scenarios.name: SK-GT-4 DuoBody 6.86 nM, E:T 4:1
scenarios.description: High-5T4 tumor-cell profile for exploring how strong target expression shapes the synapse-to-killing response.
scientific_questions: How does the high-5T4, low-resistance SK-GT-4 profile alter 72-hour killing?
interpretation_guardrails: The cell-line killing group is a fitted categorical covariate and is not derived from 5T4 abundance.
The no-donor fixed effect is donor group 2.
Do not infer clinical esophageal-tumor efficacy.
